- **Spec 3 iron rules** — Plan f"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"irst · test first (TDD red→green) · scope declaration. A spec missing any of these is not shippable."},{"id":"p11s6","text":"

- **Write-back via"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" cwd** — `cd <project> && dsh --profile headless "task"` writes straight back. No /tmp mirrors, no p"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"atch handoffs.

| Routine stages on Flash ship without rework | 3/3 stages — TD"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"D red→green, all gates green, real-browser walkthrough passed |
